ops.title: Confirm-step backend: Cerebras gpt-oss-120b, chosen by measurement
ops.body:
The confirm step (captain_hook/confirm.py) defaults to Cerebras gpt-oss-120b at reasoning effort low through spawnllm's OpenAiEndpointBackend, reading CEREBRAS_API_KEY. Measured with `uv run python -m bench.confirm --calls 20` on 2026-10-01 PT (full table attached as latency.md):

- Cerebras gpt-oss-120b (low): p50 320 ms, p95 658 ms, 0/20 failures, 17/20 correct.
- Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b (none): p50 332 ms, p95 795 ms, 0/20 failures, 8/20 correct.
- codex gpt-5.6-luna:low: p50 3872 ms, p95 7337 ms, 20/20 correct.
- Apple on-device: p50 2800 ms, p95 4345 ms, 7/20 correct.
- Claude SDK haiku: p50 15914 ms, p95 22866 ms.
- `claude -p --model haiku`: 20/20 failed, 401 expired OAuth token in spawnllm's isolated config home (spawnllm defect, open).
- Direct Anthropic API: skipped, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the machine.

Only the two Cerebras models clear a 3 s p95. Re-run the bench before changing the default; without the key every confirm allows with a failure note.
